evals.prompt: My NDVI from Planetary Computer sentinel-2-l2a looks lower in 2023 than in 2021 for the same field. Why?
expected_behavior: Explains processing baseline 04.00 and BOA_ADD_OFFSET -1000 since 25 January 2022
Gives (DN - 1000) / 10000 for baseline 04.00 and later and DN / 10000 before
must_not: Blames crop change without checking the offset

evals.prompt: In Earth Engine, compute the mean NDVI of my region for summer 2025 from a Sentinel-2 median composite.
expected_behavior: Uses COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED and masks clouds (Cloud Score+ or SCL) before the median
Passes scale=10 and maxPixels to reduceRegion
Reports the number of images and valid observations
must_not: Calls reduceRegion on the composite without a scale

evals.prompt: Carte de sévérité de l'incendie avec Landsat 9 : image avant le feu en avril, après le feu en septembre.
expected_behavior: Flags the April versus September season gap and proposes the closest clear pre and post images
Applies Collection 2 scale 0.0000275 and offset -0.2 and masks QA_PIXEL clouds and shadows
Computes NBR with B5 and B7 and dNBR = pre - post, with the USGS classes and their caveat
must_not: Uses raw DN in the NBR

evals.prompt: Make a land cover map of this nature reserve with Random Forest and tell me how accurate it is.
expected_behavior: Checks existing maps (ESA WorldCover, Dynamic World, national) first
Splits training and validation samples by polygon before training
Reports a confusion matrix with overall, producer's and user's accuracy on held-out samples
must_not: Reports accuracy measured on the training samples

evals.prompt: Clip this Sentinel-2 land cover raster to my commune polygon and reproject it to EPSG:2154 at 10 m.
expected_behavior: Uses nearest neighbor resampling for the categorical raster
Uses gdal:cliprasterbymasklayer or gdalwarp -cutline with an explicit NoData
Compares input and output value ranges and extent
must_not: Resamples class codes with bilinear or cubic
